needed.suggestion: Construct a formal sidewalk on the right side of the road to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

needed.evidence: market stalls and goods blocking the walking area
needed.suggestion: Relocate the market stalls to a designated vending area to clear the pedestrian path.

needed.evidence: uneven ground and debris on the informal path
needed.suggestion: Level and pave the informal path on the left side to remove trip hazards.

needed.evidence: commercial activity on both sides with no designated crossing facility
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing to safely facilitate movement between the shops and the road.

needed.evidence: urban area with no visible street lamps
needed.suggestion: Install street lighting along this urban stretch to improve visibility and safety at night.
